_comment: The block to merge into tauri.conf.json when the updater is wired in.
It is kept out of the real config on purpose: a `plugins.updater` section
with a placeholder pubkey is a config that looks wired and is not, and the
first person to read it would believe the till updates itself.
1. npx tauri signer generate   -- back the private half up twice
4. replace <PUBKEY> and <OWNER>/<REPO> below, then merge into tauri.conf.json
6. pass the plugin into tauriUpdateSource() -- see apps/pos/src/core/updater.ts
installMode is 'passive' so the shopkeeper sees a progress bar and not an
NSIS wizard with questions about install directories. The app is already
closed at that point; a question nobody answers leaves the till down.
